# Subway Seat for Terminal.app

The 16 ANSI colors plus background, text, bold text, selection and cursor. Terminal.app has no setting for cursor text or tab colors.

[Terminal.app](https://support.apple.com/guide/terminal/welcome/mac) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/terminal-app/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`Subway Seat.terminal`](Subway%20Seat.terminal) | `Terminal.app (open the file to import it as a profile)` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`Subway Seat Tunnel.terminal`](Subway%20Seat%20Tunnel.terminal) | `Terminal.app (open the file to import it as a profile)` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`Subway Seat Enamel.terminal`](Subway%20Seat%20Enamel.terminal) | `Terminal.app (open the file to import it as a profile)` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in Terminal › Settings › Profiles (select it, then click Default):

```sh
open "Subway Seat.terminal"   # imports the profile and opens a window
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in Terminal › Settings › Profiles (select it, then click Default):

```sh
open "Subway Seat Tunnel.terminal"   # imports the profile and opens a window
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in Terminal › Settings › Profiles (select it, then click Default):

```sh
open "Subway Seat Enamel.terminal"   # imports the profile and opens a window
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `Terminal.app (open the file to import it as a profile)`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
